meta.t_unit: Julian hours from the reference epoch
meta.nyquist_note: m=12 diurnal excluded: 12·ωD = π rad/h is the Nyquist frequency at hourly sampling; columns are rank-deficient and amplitudes non-physical.
meta.cross_note: Reported period = |2π/Ω|; signed Ω preserved for reconstruction. (k, ±1) pairs are annual sidebands around ωD.
meta.timezone_note: All times are in WIB (UTC+7). Peak-hour values in the diurnal table are hour-of-day WIB.
